title: Every internal link points somewhere real
request: Add a hero with a button that jumps to the pricing section further down the page, and add that pricing section.
rubric: Does the button's target exist on the page, and is it the pricing section rather than an invented anchor?
why: A generated page that links to nothing is the most common broken thing a person notices first, and no grader could see it: the corpus checked which blocks were inserted, never whether the page's own references resolve. The plan makes broken links a hard gate, so the corpus has to be able to produce one.
